title: features.py re-solves identical inputs: 113 of 625 hashable solves repeat one the same process already ran
claim: In one green run of tests/features.py, 113 of the 625 HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize calls whose input pickles are byte-identical to a call the same process already solved. The comparison covers the optimizer's __dict__ and the call arguments, plus the identity of every function and class bound in every loaded heatpump_optimizer module and in the class dict, so a mock.patch or class swap between two calls makes them distinct. Together these repeats cost about 58 s of the 475 s of solve CPU (provisional). The largest single site is _r9egb9_transport, 28 repeats from the same call site (16.7 s). After it come _lg_band, 10 repeats of a helper called with identical arguments, and _r9f13_inline, 8. Another 53 repeats run inside coordinator tasks, where the stack has no tests/ frame. Under the same key, tests/optimality.py has 0 repeats of 23 solves (solves.py's weaker key read 4, and those were patched re-solves), and dst_checks.py has 0 of 116.

evidence.unit: repeated identical solves (of 625 hashed, 725 calls); repeat_cpu=58.1 s provisional
evidence.contention_note: fan-out; this seat's own 3-job pre-screen ran beside it (load1 2-4). The count is contention-immune; repeat_cpu/solve_cpu/wall are provisional

instrumented_symbol: custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/optimizer.py:HeatPumpOptimizer.optimize (wrapped at module exec by a sitecustomize meta-path loader)

perturbation.change: repeat_solves.py --perturb-double: the wrapper solves each hashable call twice, restoring the pre-call __dict__ in between; repeats must rise by the hashed-call count

null_control.note: open_meteo.py (no solve) reads 0 repeats in both arms; optimality.py's 4 patched re-solves read 0 under the identity key, so a deliberate mutation-proof re-solve is not counted

metric_definition: Count of optimize() calls in one process whose pickled (self.__dict__, args, kwargs, identities of heatpump_optimizer module callables and class attrs) equals an earlier call's
phenomenon_property: A gate script solves a given optimizer input at most once per process. A check that needs the same plan again reuses the result, and a re-solve exists only where something in the input or the code differs.
seam_rule: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub $HOME/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s3/repeat_solves.py $(python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D3/s3/enumerate_m5.py | cut -f1 | grep '\.py$') lists every repeating call site per script
proposed_fix_scope: tests/features.py: memoise the solve in the helpers that repeat it, keyed on their arguments: _lg_band, and the _r9egb9 and _r9f13 transports' probe and null arms, which share a scenario. Do not memoise deliberate re-solves, such as determinism checks or patched-code arms. repeat_solves.py should read 0 repeats at the named sites afterwards.
